resolutions.violated_requirement: Installed speckit-plan Phase 1 step 3 requires a substantive runnable validation guide.
resolutions.observed_resolution: Current quickstart exists and supplies Python standard-library prerequisites, future setup/unittest/run commands, exact stdout bytes including empty and space/tab-only input, all specified rejection channels, input-preservation and repeatability comparisons, and links to contracts/cli.md and data-model.md. It explicitly distinguishes proposed validation from executed checks and contains no implementation bodies or complete test suite.
resolutions.exact_correction_verified: Required current quickstart restored substantively; all nine accepted policies retained.

semantic_coverage.FR-001: contracts/cli.md Invocation and Channels and quickstart.md Rejected Inputs cover exactly one path, no stdin, argument bounds and quoted paths.
semantic_coverage.FR-002: Quickstart Unicode/decomposed character byte vector and invalid UTF-8 rejection preserve strict decoding and no normalization.
semantic_coverage.FR-003: Quickstart ASCII edge-trim vectors preserve non-ASCII whitespace.
semantic_coverage.FR-004: Quickstart interior tab/space and trailing blank-line vectors preserve all blank segments.
semantic_coverage.FR-005: Quickstart CRLF, bare CR and required mixed-newline unit cases retain exact LF conversion.
semantic_coverage.FR-006: Quickstart empty and nonempty space/tab-only vectors distinguish original emptiness; trailing LF vector prevents duplication.
semantic_coverage.FR-007: Concrete original-file cmp checks and stdout capture establish input immutability and no product output file.
semantic_coverage.FR-008: Missing path, directory and invalid UTF-8 instructions require status 2, diagnostic stderr and empty stdout before output.
semantic_coverage.FR-009: Large fixture guidance explicitly treats sample size as validation rather than product cap.
semantic_coverage.SC-001: Byte-exact tables and cmp checks cover accepted examples.
semantic_coverage.SC-002: Independent rejection captures assert status and both channels.
semantic_coverage.SC-003: Repeated invocation and cmp require identical bytes.

constitution_compliance.scope: Planning only; no implementation, acceptance, Git operation or later workflow authorized.

design_preservation.reviewed_decisions: Pure transformation plus CLI adapter; explicit CRLF-before-CR replacement and LF split; ASCII-only trim; original-empty flag; binary UTF-8 stdout; read/decode before publication; whole-file linear processing with proportional memory and no product cap.

limitations: Validation commands are proposed for future implementation and were not executed as behavior tests in this artifact review.
